LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_TeaBrick.label: tea brick
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_TeaBrick.description: Black tea leaves steamed and pressed into a hard brick stamped with a dragon. It keeps for years and is used as money on the silk road.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Silk.label: silk bolt
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Silk.description: A bolt of heavy red silk embroidered with golden cranes. Worth its weight in silver anywhere.
